text.text_excerpt: Very popular gay bar. It can get very crowded on the weekends and during events but in a fun way. You most likely won't get a seat but you aren't there to sit! The bartenders are some of the best in the FQ! I've never waited long for a drink or to close a tab. There is always great music and the videos are hypnotizing once you get a few drinks in ya. It's a great spot to finish your night in. Or maybe I should say you won't be able to go anywhere else after the 700 club. You'll be more then satisfied. The restaurant in the back is a stand out! The loaded fries with that house made cheese sauce will call to you in your sleep! Anything with the roast beef and horsey sauce is a must too! In ...

Gay or not, I really enjoy the 700 Club as the place to go to when it comes to getting nice drinks, kind bartenders, and space to sit down with friends. On my first trip to New Orleans, I wanted to come to a gay bar that was more quaint than Oz and more formal than Corner Pocket. They even had one of my favorite wines on tap: Nobilo Sauvignon Blanc! I want to call out Tyler for his excellent customer service and kindness for serving me and making me feel at home. If I return to New Orleans, the 700 Club is one of the handful of places I would always recommend.

700 Club is slowly becoming my favorite bar int he quarter. Such a refreshing and fun atmosphere. This place literally brings in every type of person whether they are straight, gay, transgender. The music is completely on both ends of the spectrum which will get any person nodding their head. I recommend this place. Only suggestion to the establishment. Bar tenders could be more outgoing. They tend to be a bit stiff and it might be just the strange weekend nights that I go.
